high_level_description: The image shows a person standing outdoors on what appears to be an airport tarmac or a similar paved area. The individual is wearing a long, flowing red dress with intricate floral embellishments at the hem and sleeves. The dress has a fitted bodice and a flared skirt that reaches the ankles. The person's hands are placed on their hips, and they are wearing high-heeled shoes with a patterned design and teal-colored toe caps. In the background, there is a large vehicle, possibly an airport service vehicle or a truck, with visible wheels and part of its body.
